scripts.text: This is Monster Information Retrieval System. Information of the monsters that appear in this dungeon can be searched. Enter Monster Name, including spaces, when searching.
scripts.translation: 这里是魔物信息检索系统，可查询当前迷宫中出现的魔物。搜索时请输入魔物名称，包括名称中的空格。

scripts.text: There is no information available for that monster.
scripts.translation: 没有找到该魔物的信息。
请检查魔物名称是否正确。

scripts.text: Would you like to search for other monster information?
scripts.translation: 还要查询其他魔物的信息吗？

scripts.text: Monster search system will now shut down.
scripts.translation: 魔物搜索系统即将关闭。

scripts.text: Requested information will appear - There's no problem if it appears
scripts.translation: 请求的信息将显示在这里。只要能正常显示，就没有问题。

scripts.text: For more Information on the monsters

In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
scripts.translation: 为了让冒险者轻松愉快地环游世界，我们将各地冒险者收集到的信息公之于众。如发现需要修正之处，请向冒险者团体提供线索。

scripts.text: Ant Hell dungeon is infested with gigantic insects, when one is attacked others may join the fight.
scripts.translation: 蚂蚁地狱迷宫里栖息着巨大的昆虫。攻击其中一只时，其他昆虫也可能加入战斗。

scripts.text: <Maya Purple? What the hell difference with Maya! Hand who knows--I wonder Grape killing explorer.>
scripts.translation: <狂暴蚁后？它和蚁后有什么区别啊！谁知道呢——探险家葡萄也被搞糊涂了。>

scripts.text: <The Queen of ants! Boss Monster Maya! I view it's disgusting - huh? Maya did not get two? Okay I got it. Drop the rock! - Maya love grape explorer>
scripts.translation: <蚂蚁女王！魔物首领蚁后！真恶心——咦？蚁后不止一只吗？好吧，我懂了。岩石掉下来啦！——蚁后喜欢葡萄探险家>

scripts.text: Caution! Geffen Dungeon consists of 3 levels that are too dangerous for new adventurers. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
scripts.translation: 注意！吉芬地下城共有3层，对新手冒险者来说十分危险。如有信息需要补充或修正，请告知冒险者团体。

scripts.text: Which part of the dungeon would you like to read about?
scripts.translation: 您想查看地下城的哪一部分？

scripts.text: <This dungeon is home to the rare spawn sword monster Ogretooth.>
scripts.translation: <稀有魔物兽牙怪会在这里出没。它是一种持剑的魔物。>

scripts.text: <The home of demonic ponies, cute demons and puppet demons. If you like demons, you should get in here.>
scripts.translation: <恶魔小马、可爱的小恶魔和傀儡娃娃都栖息在这里。喜欢恶魔系魔物的话，就来这里看看吧。>

scripts.text: Glast Heim is an enormous dungeon with countless levels. Recommended for adventurers levels 70~130.
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆是一座规模庞大的地下城，内部层数众多。建议等级：70～130级。

scripts.text: The dungeons consist of several underground levels connected by ancient tunnels. Be prepared for attacks from Undead or demonic monsters within.
scripts.translation: 地下城的多个地下区域由古老隧道相连。深入其中时，请提防不死系和恶魔系魔物的袭击。

scripts.text: Nogg road is a B2 dungeon that houses fierce monsters. Inexperienced adventurer should not enter this place. Furthermore roads within the dungeon are very narrow, so be careful to not cause inconvenience to other players.
scripts.translation: 熔岩地下城 B2 栖息着凶猛的魔物，不适合没有经验的冒险者前往。另外，地下城里的通道非常狭窄，请小心行走，避免妨碍其他玩家。

scripts.text: <B1 is too hot.. B2 is also hot, but not hot as B1~ - Melted Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <B1热得受不了...B2也很热，但还没B1那么热~——快融化的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Mjolnir Dead Pit is a dungeon comprised of B3 levels. This place is designed for beginner to intermediate adventurers. Adventurers may want to visit this dungeon to obtain Various ores can be found in this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 这里共有地下3层，适合初级到中级冒险者探索，还能找到各种矿石。
妙勒尼尔废弃矿坑 B1
妙勒尼尔废弃矿坑 B2
妙勒尼尔废弃矿坑 B3

scripts.text: <B2 of the dungeon is practically a labyrinth of tunnels created by Skel Workers. Be careful to not to get lost in the labyrinth. I didn't have any problem, but you might have some. - Expert Navigator Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <B2几乎就是骷髅工人挖出来的隧道迷宫。小心别在里面迷路。我倒是没问题，不过你就难说了。——资深向导探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: <Monsters regularly surround you in mass numbers. It happens all the time !! I'm glad I brought flywings. Phew ~ - Ragged Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <魔物总是成群结队地围上来！还好我带了苍蝇翅膀。呼~——衣衫褴褛的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: A twisty, turny maze with varying levels of monsters within.
scripts.translation: 这里是一座蜿蜒曲折的迷宫，栖息着不同等级的魔物。

scripts.text: Forest of Labyrinth is comprised of B3 floors, where various monsters reside in 1, 2, B3. Be well prepared before venturing to this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 迷宫森林共有B1、B2、B3三层，各层栖息着不同的魔物。进入前请做好充分准备。

scripts.text: <Looking at all those Baphomet Jr., Don't you think Baphomet is vigorous? No? - Jealous Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <看着这么多小巴风特，你不觉得巴风特很有精神吗？没有吗？——嫉妒的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Sphinx is comprised of 5 underground floors. This dungeon's difficulty is appropriate for intermediate to expert adventurers. All monsters in this dungeon are aggressive, so adventurers are advised to have a method to escape in emergencies.
scripts.translation: 斯芬克斯共有地下5层，适合中级到高级冒险者探索。这里的魔物全都具有攻击性，建议准备好紧急脱身的手段。

scripts.text: <Selling Pharaoh Mask~ Oops.. Sorry, when I saw Pharaoh, I remembered a bard's farfetched story. - Frozen Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <出售法老王面具~哎呀...抱歉，看到法老王就让我想起吟游诗人讲过的那个离谱故事。——冻僵的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Clock Tower Dungeon is comprised of B4 ground floors and B4 underground floors. Warp points inside the dungeon are complex, sending adventurers to random locations. Exercise caution to not get lost inside the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 钟楼地下城有地上4层、地下4层。内部传送点错综复杂，会把冒险者随机传送到不同地点。请小心探索，别迷路了。

scripts.text: <Owl Duke's lightning bolt hurts! - Bankrupt Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <鹗枭首领的雷电攻击真疼！——破产的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: <Bathory.. is it a grandma? girl? it'd be better if it was a girl? Don't you agree? - Starsand hunting Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <巴托里...是老奶奶，还是少女？要是少女就好了，你说呢？——寻找星星沙的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.

scripts.text: Orc Dungeon is comprised of 2 floors. Monsters that appear in this dungeon are not strong individually, but adventurers may be overwhelmed by the number. Holy element weapons will make adventurer's life easier in this dungeon. You can also utilize Priest skill, Aspersio.
scripts.translation: 兽人地下城共有2层。这里的魔物单体并不强，但常常成群出现，冒险者可能招架不住。使用圣属性武器，或服用牧师技能“洒水祈福”赋予武器圣属性，会更容易应对。

scripts.text: <Why are there so many monsters?? There are way too many... - Irritated Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <怎么有这么多魔物？！简直多得离谱...——不耐烦的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Juperos Ruins is comprised to 2 floors that can be accessed normally, and 1 center floor that can only be accessed by completing specific challenges.
scripts.translation: 朱佩罗斯遗迹有两层可正常进入的区域，另有一层中枢区域，必须完成特定挑战才能抵达。
朱佩罗斯遗迹 中枢

scripts.text: <Whoever that's reading this! Have you seen MVP monster, Vesper?? I can't understand! How is that a brute? Just how could it be... - Conspiracy suspecting Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <读到这段话的人，你见过MVP魔物贝思波吗？我实在想不通！它怎么会被算作蛮力型？这到底是怎么回事...——怀疑阴谋的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Byalan Island's Undersea Tunnel is comprised of 6 floors. This dungeon is appropriate for beginners to expert adventurers. Most monsters in this dungeon are water element, therefore having wind element weapons will prove to be helpful.
scripts.translation: 拜兰岛海底隧道共有6层，适合从新手到资深冒险者探索。这里的魔物大多是水属性，使用风属性武器会很有帮助。
依斯鲁得海底隧道 B1
依斯鲁得海底隧道 B2
依斯鲁得海底隧道 B3
依斯鲁得海底隧道 B4
依斯鲁得海底隧道 B5
依斯鲁得海底隧道 B6

scripts.text: <Where is this? You don't know? Are you scared? This is definitely underwater, but I can breathe. Did I just grow gills out of nowhere? - Silly Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <这是哪里？你不知道吗？害怕了？这里肯定在水下，可我居然还能呼吸。难道我突然长出鳃了？——糊涂的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: <Kraken is a squid? But why does it have octopus legs?! A.. Amazing..? - Visiting Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <魔鬼大乌贼明明是乌贼，为什么长着章鱼脚？！太...太神奇了...？——来访的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Toy Factory is comprised of 2 floors. Strong monsters sometimes appear within the dungeon. This dungeon is appropriate for leisure adventure experience, however some caution should be exercised.
scripts.translation: 玩具工厂共有2层，偶尔会出现强大的魔物。这里适合轻松探索，但也不能掉以轻心。

scripts.text: <Do you think Porings are cute? Would you change your mind if you met Angeling? It loves harassing people. Be wary of Angeling beginners! Be wary! That's all~ - Orc masked explorer grape>
scripts.translation: <你觉得波利很可爱吗？见到天使波利后，你可能就不这么想了。它最喜欢捉弄人。新手们要小心天使波利！千万小心！就这样~——戴着兽人面具的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: <I approached a new monster out of sheer curiosity. I actually witnessed it. Stormy Knight with red nose with christmas stockings on its feet, commandeering cookie monsters!! I might just become its fan. - Thick glove-wearing explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <我纯粹是好奇，才凑近看了看那只新魔物。没想到竟亲眼看到冰暴骑士——红鼻子、脚穿圣诞袜——指挥着饼干魔物！！我可能要变成它的粉丝了。——戴厚手套的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Sunken Ship is not completely submerged in water, allowing access to a total of 2 floors. Despite the size of the map, many monsters appear in this dungeon. Exercise caution inside the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 沉船并未完全沉入水中，共有2层可以探索。地图虽不大，却有大量魔物出没，请务必小心。

scripts.text: <Ghostring runs away when it sees me.. It must be shy. Former captain of this sunken ship is also very rude. Pfft~! - Jealous of Captain's hat, Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <幽灵波利看到我时会逃跑...它一定是害羞了。这艘沉船的前任船长也很无礼。哼~！ - 嫉妒船长帽子的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: East Cave, Mao is a tunnel that leads to Papuchicha Forest. This place is popular for highly sought after cards, Thara Frog and Hydra. Visit this place if you are in dire need of zeny.
scripts.translation: 茂洞是一条通往普勒斯特森林的隧道。达拉蛙卡片和海葵卡片很受欢迎，急需Zeny的话不妨来这里碰碰运气。

scripts.text: <Thara Frog.. It's just a frog right? Ew.. It looks hideous.. - Frog loving Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <达拉蛙...它只是一只青蛙对吧？呕...它看起来很丑陋... - 喜爱青蛙的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: This dungeon introduces Medusa monster that will surely cause you to turn to stone if you look at it in the eyes. There are no other exits in this cave.
scripts.translation: 这里栖息着米杜沙。只要直视它的眼睛，就会变成石头。这座洞穴没有其他出口。

scripts.text: <Tao Gunka? That monster with huge face? How strong is it? It's weak.. very weak.. Oh!! It might be strong for you.. - Trolling Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <塔奥群卡？就是那个大脸魔物吗？它有多强？弱得很...真的很弱...哦！！对你来说可能挺强...——爱捉弄人的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Adventurers can reach Umbala by going through Ruande cave. Stalactic Golem monster can only be seen in this cave.
scripts.translation: 通过鲁安德洞穴可以前往汶巴拉。钟乳巨石怪只在这座洞穴中出没。

scripts.text: <Stalactic Golem? Phew~ Why did I come here? Ah! That's right I came here to go to Umbala..!! - Passing explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <钟乳巨石怪？呼~我为什么跑来这里？啊，对了！我是要从这里去汶巴拉的...！——路过的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Payon Cave is comprised of 5 floors. Most monsters are Undead or Demon. Holy property weapons will prove to be useful in this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 斐扬洞穴共有5层，里面大多是不死系或恶魔系魔物。使用圣属性武器会更容易应对。

scripts.text: <Cat O'Nine Tails wears an underwear, but I'm not wearing one. Hey you over there, don't just watch!! - Extremely embarrassed Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <九尾狐居然穿着内裤，可我没穿。喂，那边那位，别光看着啊！！——尴尬到不行的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.

scripts.text: Pyramid is comprised of B4 ground floors and B3 underground floors. This dungeon is appropriate for beginner to expert adventurers. Thief Guild is located in underground B1 floor.
scripts.translation: 金字塔有地上4层、地下3层，适合从新手到资深冒险者探索。盗贼公会位于地下B1层。

scripts.text: <King of the pyramid! I should change his bandages. His bandages have turned purple over the ages. He's dangerous? It's ok~ It's ok~ - Bandage carrying Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <金字塔之王！我该帮他换换绷带了，都放了这么多年，绷带都变紫了。他很危险吗？没事的~没事的~——随身带着绷带的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: <There's an MVP monster that attacks while sitting on its chair. He must have been very lazy. It didn't even move from the spot. That happens to be sometimes. - Lazy Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <有只MVP魔物坐在椅子上发动攻击。它一定懒得很，连位置都没挪过。偶尔也会遇到这种事。——懒散的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Abyss Lake Dungeon is comprised of B3 floors, and monsters in this dungeon are mostly Dragon race. Prepare yourself before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 深渊之湖地下城共有3层，里面的魔物大多属于龙族。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Detardeurus is so big!! Doesn't it look strong? If you are not interested, nevermind. - Eager to ride the dragon, Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <迪塔勒泰晤勒斯好大啊！！看起来很强，对吧？不感兴趣就算啦。——想骑龙的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Einbech Dungeon is comprised of 2 floors, and most of the monsters that appear in this dungeon are Formless. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 艾音贝赫地下城共有2层，里面的魔物大多属于无形种族。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <RSX-0806 ... That name is complex. - Intelligent Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <RSX-0806...这名字真复杂。——聪明的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Ice Cave is comprised of B3 floors, and most monsters within the dungeon are Water element. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 冰洞共有3层，里面的魔物大多是水属性。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Rare monster Ktullanux.. Sigh.. Even it's name is complex.. How would Ktullanux ice shave taste like? - Ice shave hungering Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <稀有魔物克图拉纳克斯...唉...名字也这么复杂...不知道克图拉纳克斯口味的刨冰会是什么样？——馋冰沙的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Thor Volcano Dungeon is comprised of B3 floors, and the monsters that appear in this dungeon are mostly Fire element. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 托尔火山地下城共有3层，里面的魔物大多是火属性。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Young explorer~ Why are you here in Thor Volcano Dungeon~ Why are you crying~ Wah~ Wah~ Ifrit is scalding hot~ - Thor Sauna representative explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <年轻的探险家~你为什么跑到托尔火山地下城来~哭什么呀~哇~哇~伊夫利特烫死人了~——托尔桑拿代表探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Odin Temple is comprised of 3 areas , and most monsters that appear here have fast movement speed. Be prepared to get ambushed by multiple monsters.
scripts.translation: 奥丁神殿共有3个区域，里面的魔物大多移动速度很快。小心被多只魔物同时伏击。

scripts.text: <Valkyrie Randgris, how I wish to be wrapped around your soft wings - Dreamy explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <兰特克力斯啊，我多希望能被你柔软的翅膀拥入怀中。——做着美梦的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Starlight Reef introduces rather weak monsters. Be careful around Red Eruma monsters as it will assist other monsters in its vicinity. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 这里的魔物相对弱小。不过要小心红海星，它会协助附近的其他魔物。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Wild Rider..? Huh? Is it a cat? Why is a cat riding on a swordfish? - Mounted on picky, explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <野猫骑士...咦？是猫吗？猫怎么骑在剑鱼身上？——骑在小鸡背上的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Ancient Elf's lost city, Geffenia is comprised of 4 sections. Most monsters that appear in this dungeon are strong, so be prepared before you venture into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 吉芬尼亚是古代精灵失落的城市，共有4个区域。里面的大多数魔物都很强，进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Hey Incubus~ Look at... Ugh... - Embarrassed Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <嘿，梦魔~让我看看...呃...——害羞的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.

scripts.text: Nameless Island St. Abbey is comprised of 3 floors, and most monsters that appear in this dungeon are Undead or demon. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 无名岛修道院共有3层，里面的魔物大多是不死系或恶魔系。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Do you know how scary a Bishop can be when it becomes fallen..? Hibram.. I saw it.. - All knowing Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <你知道堕落的主教有多可怕吗...希布拉姆...我亲眼见过...——无所不知的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: <Beelzebub is not a Steel Chonchon, because Chonchons are weak. ... ... ... Run away! - Fleeing Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <贝雷杰才不是绿苍蝇，苍蝇可是弱得很... ... ...快逃！——逃跑中的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.

scripts.text: Somatology Laboratory is comprised of 3 floors, and monsters that appear are mostly Demi-human. These monsters are very powerful so be sure to explore with another adventurer.
scripts.translation: 生体实验研究所共有3层，里面的魔物大多是人类种族，而且实力强大。务必结伴探索。

scripts.text: <There are even places like these.. Conducting experiments on human specimen.. MVP Egnigem Cenia... She's.. - Tearful Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <竟然有这种地方...居然拿人体做实验...MVP暗●剑士...她...——泪眼汪汪的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: <I've finally reached here.. Who's conducting these experiments.. What did they do to these people? Eremes.. Margaretha.. Cecil.. Kathryne.. Seyren.. Howard.. ... - Extremely tearful explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <我终于来到这里了...究竟是谁在进行这些实验...他们对这些人做了什么？艾勒梅斯...玛格丽特...塞西尔...凯瑟琳...塞伦...霍华德...——悲痛欲绝的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Only those that have requested permission from High Priest Zhed may enter this dungeon. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
scripts.translation: 只有获得大祭司泽德许可的人才能进入这里。如有信息需要补充或修正，请告知冒险者团体。

scripts.text: Holy Ground is comprised of 5 floors, and monsters that appear in this dungeon use magic skills. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 圣地共有5层，里面的魔物会使用魔法。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Gloom Under Night's eyes are so round and cute. I want to make it my pet.. But what's its taming item? I probably can't tame it then.. - Hopeful Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <夜胜魔的眼睛圆溜溜的，好可爱。我想把它收作宠物...不过它的驯服道具是什么？我大概没办法驯服它吧...——满怀希望的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: - Your ^0000FFLuxurious Keycard^000000resonates with Signpost and uncovers new information. -
scripts.translation: - 你的^0000FF华丽钥匙卡^000000与路标产生共鸣，揭示了新的信息。 -

scripts.text: Kiel Hyre Academy students cannot enter here.
scripts.translation: 基尔·海尔学院的学生不能进入这里。

scripts.text: In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.

scripts.text: Robot Factory is comprised of 2 floors, and monsters that appear here are mostly formless. Constant monster self destructs to repel any invaders, so be cautious.
scripts.translation: 机器人制造工厂共有2层，里面的魔物大多属于无形种族。恒量魔会自爆击退入侵者，请务必小心。

scripts.text: <I don't know why but there are 2 types of Kiel. Kiel and Kiel-D-01... Kiel-D-01 is the newer version of the two.. Should I request Kiel to make me a robot too? - Greedy Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <我不明白为什么会有两个基尔：基尔和基尔-D-01...基尔-D-01是较新的型号...要不要拜托基尔也给我造个机器人？——贪心的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower is comprised of 12 floors, but only 3 floors are open to the public. If you wish to progress, you must have signed a contract with '^0000FFRenkenber^000000'.
scripts.translation: 塔纳托斯之塔共有12层，但只有3层对外开放。想继续深入的话，必须先与^0000FF雷根贝勒^000000签订契约。

scripts.text: According to the information there are a total of 12 floors. Prepare for all kinds of situation before venturing in this dungeon....
scripts.translation: 据资料记载，这里一共有12层。进入前，请做好应对各种状况的准备...

scripts.text: Please don't touch it. Only those that have a contract with '^0000FFRenkenber^000000' can progress.
scripts.translation: 请勿触碰。只有与^0000FF雷根贝勒^000000签订契约的人才能继续前进。

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower is comprised of 12 floors, but only 3 floors are open to the public. If you wish to progress, you must have signed a contract with'^0000FFRenkenber^000000'.
scripts.translation: 塔纳托斯之塔共有12层，但只有3层对外开放。若要继续深入，必须先与'^0000FF雷根贝勒^000000'签订契约。

scripts.text: According to the information there are a total of 12 floors. Prepare for all kinds of situation before venturing in this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 据资料记载，这里一共有12层。进入前，请做好应对各种状况的准备。

scripts.text: You have signed the contract with '^0000FFRenkenber^000000', the following information are now available. To revise the information, contact Adventurer Group or '^0000FFRenkenber^000000'with information tip.
scripts.translation: 你已与^0000FF雷根贝勒^000000签订契约，现在可以查看以下信息。如需修正，请联系冒险者团体，或向^0000FF雷根贝勒^000000提供线索。

scripts.text: Please choose an appropriate floor for monster information.
scripts.translation: 请选择要查询魔物信息的楼层。
塔纳托斯之塔 顶层

scripts.text: <It's so empty.. I came all the way up here but there's nothing here.. - Angry Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <这里空荡荡的...我一路爬到顶层，却什么也没发现...——气恼的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Prontera Culvert can only be accessed by adventurers who have the permission from Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 只有获得卢恩·米德加兹王国许可的冒险者才能进入普隆德拉下水道。

scripts.text: Prontera Culvert can only be accessed by adventurers who have signed a volunteer form at Prontera Chivalry. Would you like to go sign the volunteer form?
scripts.translation: 只有在普隆德拉骑士团签署志愿书的冒险者才能进入。要去签署志愿书吗？

scripts.text: You will be warped to Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation: 即将传送到普隆德拉骑士团。

scripts.text: Prontera Chivalry is looking to enlist brave adventurers.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉骑士团正在招募勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text: Prontera Culvert is comprised of B4 floors. This dungeon is appropriate for beginner adventurers and most monsters that appear here will assist others monsters with the same name.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉下水道共有4层，适合新手冒险者探索。这里的魔物遇袭时，附近同类也会加入战斗。

scripts.text: <There is a shiny bug living in Prontera Culvert 4F. It's called Golden Thief Bug. Prontera Sewage system regularly blocked by this monster. Ew~ It's nasty. - Irritated Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <普隆德拉下水道4楼住着一只闪闪发亮的虫子，名叫黄金虫。它经常把下水道堵住。呕~真恶心。——不耐烦的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Turtle Island is comprised of 3 floors, and the monsters that appear here are mostly brute. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 海龟岛共有3层，里面的魔物大多属于动物种族。进入前请做好准备。

scripts.text: <Turtles are known for their longevity right? How old is Turtle General? - Young explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <乌龟长寿闻名，对吧？那乌龟将军到底几岁了？——年轻的探险家葡萄>

scripts.translation: 天津町地下城共有3层，迷宫错综复杂，而且无法使用苍蝇翅膀。进入前请做好准备。
天津町地下城 - 榻榻米迷宫

scripts.text: Amatsu Dungeon - Battle Field in the Underground Forest

scripts.text: <Samurai Specter is very rude. I wanted to introduce myself to him by giving him my name card, but he wasn't happy about it.. Pfft - Dejected Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <幽灵武士真没礼貌。我本想递上名片自我介绍，他却一点也不高兴...哼。——沮丧的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Kunlun Dungeon is comprised of 3 floors. Royal Jelly and Dead Branch items can be obtained from monsters in this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 昆仑地下城共有3层。击败里面的魔物可以获得蜂胶和枯树枝。

scripts.text: Kunlun Dungeon - Shrine of Kunlun Queen
scripts.translation: 昆仑地下城 - 西王母神殿
昆仑地下城 - 仙人棋局
昆仑地下城 - 世外桃源
[昆仑地下城 - 西王母神殿]

scripts.text: <Is it true that Evil Snake Lord's caligraphy is phenomenal? I went there to take a look at it.. But I couldn't see its caligraphy.. - Forgetful Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <听说墨蛇君的书法出神入化？我特意去看了看...结果什么也没看见...——健忘的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Luoyang Dungeon is comprised of 3 floors and the monsters that appear here tend to overpower adventurers in mass numbers. Prepare before venturing into this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 龙之城地下城共有3层，魔物常常成群出没，冒险者可能会寡不敌众。进入前请做好准备。
龙之城地下城 - 审良宫
龙之城地下城 - 皇陵

scripts.text: Luoyang Dungeon - Inside the Royal Tomb
scripts.translation: 龙之城地下城 - 皇陵内部
[龙之城地下城 - 皇陵内部]

scripts.text: <White Lady.. She's.. Beautiful.. She's Kind.. If it wasn't for Green Maidens.. Pfft - Dejected Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <白素贞...她...真美...又那么善良...要不是有小青...哼。——沮丧的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text: Ayothaya Dungeon is comprised of 2 floors. Monsters in this dungeon can be found hiding in the labyrinth.
scripts.translation: 哎哟泰雅地下城共有2层，魔物会藏身在迷宫各处。
哎哟泰雅地下城 - 古神殿迷宫
哎哟泰雅地下城 - 古神殿内部
